model.determinism_policy: Same checkpoint, config, input bytes, device type and thread count give a bit-identical binary mask and probability map. Across devices or thread counts, probabilities agree to about 1e-5 and binary masks can differ only at pixels within that distance of the threshold.

category_rules.QUALITY_REJECTED: the quality gate rejected the image; no segmentation was produced
category_rules.CORRECT_EMPTY: ground truth empty and prediction empty
category_rules.FALSE_POSITIVE_ON_EMPTY: ground truth empty but the model segmented a region
category_rules.MISSED_WOUND: ground truth non-empty but the prediction is empty
category_rules.UNDER_SEGMENTATION: 0.5 <= Dice < 0.8 and predicted area < ground-truth area
category_rules.OVER_SEGMENTATION: 0.5 <= Dice < 0.8 and predicted area >= ground-truth area

flag_rules.FRAGMENTED_PREDICTION: more predicted components than ground-truth components
flag_rules.TOUCHES_BORDER: predicted region touches the image border

repeatability.policy: Same checkpoint, config, input bytes, device type and thread count give a bit-identical binary mask and probability map. Across devices or thread counts, probabilities agree to about 1e-5 and binary masks can differ only at pixels within that distance of the threshold.
